verses.pali: Ekamantaṁ nisinnaṁ kho āyasmantaṁ rādhaṁ bhagavā etadavoca:
verses.english: When Venerable Rādha was seated to one side, the Buddha said to him:

verses.pali: “yo kho, rādha, māro; tatra te chando pahātabbo, rāgo pahātabbo, chandarāgo pahātabbo.
verses.english: “Rādha, you should give up any desire, any greed, any desire and greed for whatever is Māra.

verses.pali: Rūpaṁ kho, rādha, māro; tatra te chando pahātabbo …pe…
verses.english: Form is Māra. You should give up any desire, any greed, any desire and greed for it. …

verses.pali: viññāṇaṁ māro; tatra te chando pahātabbo …pe…
verses.english: Consciousness is Māra. You should give up any desire, any greed, any desire and greed for it.

verses.pali: yo kho, rādha, māro; tatra te chando pahātabbo, rāgo pahātabbo, chandarāgo pahātabbo”ti.
verses.english: You should give up any desire, any greed, any desire and greed for whatever is Māra.”
